title: Aave V3 reserve position
description: Scoped supply, withdrawal and optional borrowing on one named reserve, with its own pinned oracle and price source. Grants carry no amount bound; repaying the fund's own debt needs no amount.

capital.description: Optional amount of the market asset the allocation starts with. The funding statement requires it before the first entry. It is not a limit: how much to supply is the strategy's decision. Defaults to zero.

borrow.description: Grant borrowing and repayment of this market asset. Supply and withdrawal are always granted; how much to borrow is the strategy's decision. Defaults to false.

collateral.description: Grant use of this reserve as collateral. On the ordinary-mode (non-eMode) reserves the SDK supports, the Aave V3 Pool enables a first supply into an empty position as collateral automatically whenever the reserve's LTV is above zero, so supplying such a reserve requires true. False fits only a zero-LTV reserve or an allocation that borrows and repays without supplying; for a new run, an allocation with neither collateral nor borrow on a reserve with nonzero LTV is refused at the online check.

minimum_health_factor.description: Minimum projected health factor for an action that adds risk. Required when borrow is true; every allocation sharing that fund and market then states the same value. Omit it on an allocation that cannot borrow in a scope where none borrows (lend- or supply-only): there is no debt for it to bound, and while the fund carries any debt in that market an action the connector risk-checks is refused.
